newsitem.title: NORWAY: Decommissioned Russian warship adrift in North Sea.
newsitem.headline: Decommissioned Russian warship adrift in North Sea.

text.p: A decommissioned Russian warship was adrift in the North Sea off Norway on Thursday after tearing loose from a tug in a storm, Norwegian officials said.

Officials at the Sola rescue centre at Stavanger said the unidentified 140-metre ship was drifting northwest of Kristiansund on the west coast, but that it posed no immediate danger to offshore oil platforms.
"The nearest platforms are 70 miles north," one official said. "It does not threaten any installation for the moment."
The ship was being towed from the Russian port of Murmansk on the Kola peninsula east of Norway to India, where it was to be scrapped.
The Russian tug Atrija was trying to link up with the vessel again, the officials said.
